answer: A bonded-sponsorship inlet gates entry: each newcomer must be vouched for by an established agent that locks collateral behind them, so the voyage of a new identity starts with a sponsor at risk. One fake account costs one bond, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds. Viewed through this prism, farming collapses: if a sponsored cluster is caught gaming rewards, every bond behind it is slashed and the sponsor loses future earnings, making mass Sybils unprofitable.
